skill_name: Compare and contrast the main similarities and differences between a computer and a smartphone
workflow: A computer and a smartphone share many similarities, as they are both electronic devices that run on a variety of operating systems, are capable of connecting to the internet, and can be used to perform a variety of tasks. However, there are also key differences between the two. Computers are more powerful and capable of performing more advanced tasks and functioning as a desktop or laptop.
